
### TCP Tahoe  {.smaller}


* <i>congestion avoidance</i> (cwnd $\ge$ ssthresh) 

   * no loss: cwnd += 1 segment per round-trip-time
   * on loss: ssthresh = cwnd/2; cwnd = $\sim$2 segments

* <i>‘‘slow start’’</i> (cwnd \< ssthresh) 

   * no loss: cwnd += 1 segment per newly ack'd segment
   * on loss: ssthresh = cwnd/2; cwnd = cwnd/2;

* <i>recovery</i> (known loss) 

   * retransmit packet after third duplicate ACK of previous packet :or timeout
